metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is enabled.

properties.displayName: Credential Added to Microsoft Entra ID Application or Service Principal
properties.description: Detects addition of new secrets or certificates to Microsoft Entra ID applications or service principals, including identities used to access organisational AI services. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1504, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-25-protect-organisations-ai-services.
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where OperationName has_any ("Update application - Certificates and secrets management", "Add service principal credentials", "Update service principal")
| where Result == "success"
| extend InitiatingUser = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend TargetAppName = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| where isnotempty(TargetAppName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, InitiatingUser, TargetAppName, Result
